column7: A panic in clearLoginFailures (UpdateLoginLockoutState), which runs after a login's session insert and Set-Cookie (and after a step-up/re-auth grant), reached the Recovery middleware: HTTP 500 carrying a live kx_session cookie, no auth.login audit. clearLoginFailures now recovers its own write (besteffort), so every caller is covered; the counter stays as the check found it. Also internal/core TestClearLoginFailures_PanicIsRecovered and TestVerifyMFAStepUp_LockoutClearPanicStillDeliversTheGrant.
